findings.title: Backups created within the same second overwrite each other
findings.body: The timestamp filename has only one-second precision and is written with File.WriteAllText. Two SaveBackup calls during the same second therefore target the same path, replacing the earlier recovery point instead of retaining it in the intended timestamped history. Generate collision-resistant names, for example by including fractional seconds and handling any remaining collision, or by using a unique suffix.
